description: Combine selected code/proxy observations, contract-reported token facts and one wallet's single-block ETH/Transfer evidence at one finalized Base block. Shared RPC cache; at most 18 reads. Wallet scope remains a restricted pilot; no complete history or security score. One fixed workflow charge; internal steps never create separate customer charges. Each call selects one finalized Base block. Reuse its contract_snapshot_id only as previous_contract_snapshot for compatible contract comparison; this workflow accepts no observation_id. Auth: authorized native-USDC x402 v2 on Base, enabled MPP, or an eligible prepaid key plus exact tariff 5 and max_credits. Ordinary unpaid calls return a challenge, not execution. Persist original input, proof and recovery token before submission; exact replay returns retained results without fresh work or another charge. Choose evidence detail before authorization. No free-trial or automatic paid fallback. 0.025 USDC or 10 credits. Limits and scope are authoritative, not a complete audit or compatibility guarantee. The same fixed x402 service price may also be paid in native Circle USDC on Solana Mainnet (solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp), when advertised by the unpaid challenge. Explicitly select one accepted network and pin its mint, merchant, amount and sponsored fee payer before signing. Solana payers need no Base wallet; MPP remains Base-only. Payment network does not change the observed chain: blockchain products still inspect finalized Base. Solana delivery requires finalized matching USDC evidence. Persist the original network, resource, input, proof and private recovery capability; never switch networks or authorize a replacement after uncertainty.

chain_id.description: Base mainnet only; provider chain is verified. All state is pinned to one selected finalized block.

contract_address.description: One selected contract which is also the token-facts and Transfer-log contract. The workflow does not infer that arbitrary bytecode is a safe or compliant token.

detail.description: Default compact: at most 20 evidence items per section. Expanded allows at most 200 document findings or 100 Base events and retains raw validated logs/getter ABI details within the same fixed work/output ceiling. Counts and omitted-evidence warnings remain explicit.

previous_contract_snapshot.description: Optional owned contract_snapshot_id from this workflow's same narrow code/proxy scope; incompatible primitive snapshots are rejected. Allows bounded selected-contract comparison.

wallet_address.description: One selected wallet. Returns its exact native-ETH balance and this contract's provider-reported Transfer events at the single selected finalized block, not complete wallet history.
